text:
samira: Quick q — friend dropping off a demo kit + pastry at 9:30 tomorrow. Can front desk hold the pastry in fridge and stash the kit until I escort it upstairs? cc @frontdesk :wave:
frontdesk: Yup we can hold both. Please label the pastry with name + date and add 'perishable'. Small kits (<5kg) we keep at desk; larger go to Mailroom C. If courier is early, ask them to ring bell.
jules: I can clear a fridge shelf at 9:15. Also heads-up: if pastry has nuts, please flag in the label so we avoid cross-contamination.
hugo: Will the kit need special handling? If fragile, mark FRAGILE and we'll put it on the soft-mat in staging.
samira: Not fragile, but awkward shape. I'll ask courier to deliver at 9:25 so we have time. Label format I'll use: "Samira - demo kit - hold for Samira - 03/28". Is that OK?
frontdesk: Perfect. If courier wants to leave at loading dock, pre-register plate here: https://redwood.example/dock-pass or DM us.
mailroom-bot: Note: Mailroom C lockers at 88% capacity. Large items may be routed to Offsite B if they can't fit. To hold at front desk include tag "hold-for-samira".
people-ops-bot: Temp badge ready if you need one. Run: POST /visitors/create or use QR: https://redwood.example/checkin/tmp-2156
samira: No badge needed, just me picking up. Quick poll for snack preferences: Reply with "pastry" if you want a piece, or "skip" if not. I'll bring 6 slices.
jules: pastry
hugo: skip (thanks!)
frontdesk: We'll keep one visitor sticker + the hold tag at the desk. If the kiosk shows an error, use manual form: https://redwood.example/manual-visitor. We'll call Samira when courier arrives.
samira: Thanks team :pray: Also, can someone move the north-high table closer to the kitchen at 10:00? It'll be easier for setup.
jules: can do at 9:55
hugo: can help move if needed
people-ops-bot: Reminder: label shared fridge items with owner + date to avoid accidental disposal. Thanks!
